facts.fact: Nigeria's Presidential Working Group on the National Policing Bill opened the portal www.nigeriapolicebill.com on 3 August 2026 for the public to contribute proposals to the bill.

systems.owner: Presidential Working Group on the National Policing Bill

NGA.note: Nothing on station records; the bill is not a station record system.
No local research institution named as researching or feeding digital policy.
The consultation is on a policing bill, not a digital law or policy.
Mentions national policing standards only; no IT or data standards body or standard.
